        if comp == '.':
            # Skip '.'
            i += 1
            continue
        elif comp == '..':
            # Move to parent
            if current != '/':
                # Remove the last component from current
                current = current.rsplit('/', 1)[0]

            if current == '/':

                link_count += 1

                    return None
                
                # Get the symlink target
                target = links[potential]
                
                # Resolve the target relative to the directory containing the link
                if target.startswith('/'):
                    # Absolute symlink target

                    target_remaining = target[1:]

                    # Relative symlink target - relative to the directory containing the link
                    current = potential.rsplit('/', 1)[0]

                components = target_components + components[i+1:]
                i = 0
                continue

                # Not a symlink, update current
                current = potential
                i += 1
    
    # Remove trailing slash except for '/'
    if current != '/' and current.endswith('/'):
        current = current.rstrip('/')
    
    return current
